733530101.text: #Excuse me. Are you {NICKNAME}, by any chance?

733530104.text: Ah, good! Good thing I didn't get the wrong person.

733530105.text: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Dharmakirti, a Dastur from Amurta.

733530106.text: We've heard of you, of course, but in truth, we don't know much about you.

733530107.text: But we've been doing research on dreamscapes lately, and the Dendro Archon informed us that you were the most cool-headed person she's ever seen when distinguishing dreams from reality.

733530109.text: Nay, don't be so modest. Anyway, that's precisely what our project is about, and our data indicates that people struggle to consciously wake up after falling asleep.

733530110.text: We intend to utilize the psychological influence that dreams have on people to help regulate various psychological disorders.

733530111.text: Specifically, we will use targeted environmental hints and guidance based on each patient's individual situation to create a suitable dreamscape for them.

733530112.text: The technology to enter shared dreamscapes is still rather new, and advancements are mainly thanks to the many improvements made by the Dendro Archon. Simply put, our goal is to address patients' psychological problems by adjusting their cognitive states within dreamscapes.

733530114.text: Ah, right. Sorry. Couldn't help rambling on about our project a bit. It is quite complicated, yes...

733530115.text: Simply put, we're conducting medical research on the psychological effects of dreams, but we've gotten a bit stuck when it comes to practical implementation...
